caption:
Leftover Pasta Recipe
i opened my fridge and had some pasta and leftover grilled chicken so i made this delicious 10 minute paste :) if making the pasta and chicken from scratch, it’ll take 20 minutes 💕

Macros:
C: 41 | F: 17 | P: 45
Calories: 498 per portion 
Serves 1

Ingredients: 
20-30 grams cooked pasta
1 tsp oil
2 tbsp minced garlic
2 heaping teaspoons tomato paste
1 tbsp amul cream
2-3 tbsp milk ( can use whole or low fat, doesn’t matter)
protein: 1 chicken breast OR 80 grams paneer 
any vegetables you want
chopped coriander to garnish 

Method:
add oil to the pan and add garlic- saute and allow to crisp up
add in the tomato paste and saute for a minute, add in cream + milk
mix for another minute then add in your chopped protein- ive used leftover chicken breast diced up | add in some water to thin out the sauce 
you can add in any veges you want and top with cheese if you’d like :)
